Evidence: Gill quotes, RNC speeches, 2028 framing
#Aletheia #USPol

Rep. Brandon Gill frames Vice President JD Vance as the undisputed GOP front-runner for 2028 due to his strong leadership and policy support.

Beneath the convention rhetoric lies an aggressive early factional consolidation designed to lock out rivals and preempt open debate.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.7, -0.8) — Lesser Evil

Early 2028 coronation talk masks internal factional maneuvering under the guise of party unity.

- Brandon Gill: FAIL (-0.7, -0.8) — Secures internal loyalty via premature framing.
- RNC Platform Framing: FAIL (-0.6, -0.7) — Projects unity while tightening elite grip.
At the RNC midterm convention in Dallas, lawmakers like Rep. Brandon Gill are already shaping the 2028 presidential landscape by anointing key administration figures.

The Bright Side:
Clear alignment helps voters understand current intra-party power structures early on.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing WHAT (policy debate) with WHO (elite succession chess), bypassing broad voter deliberation.

Social Physics Analysis:
Actors execute a Smart Selfish Maneuver. They deploy loyalty pretexts to manufacture an inevitable succession narrative, projecting party strength while shielding inner circles from open contest.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Factional entrenchment overrides open democratic deliberation.

The Unavoidable Truth: Early endorsements cement elite alliances long before voters weigh in.

The Unavoidable Lie: This premature coronation reflects spontaneous grassroots consensus.

Alethekanon:
Premature succession framing substitutes loyalty tests for genuine policy debate, steering politics toward closed factional control.

Awwthekanon:
It is easy to get swept up in the excitement of political momentum, but true leadership invites everyone to the table rather than anointing successors early.

Brothekanon:
They are already starting the 2028 horse race while the midterms are still happening? Classic Washington multitasking.

Spirithekanon:
"Let another praise you, and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips." Proverbs 27:2 FAIL
Self-serving proclamations of future power replace quiet integrity with premature ambition.
